svg.text: Double the side wall → swing it inward → fold the whole strip
Actual kernel poses · shared orthographic scale; each 3D view recentered · material-layer and rigid-panel checks
Blue line: active hinge Green dashed lines: seal guides Pink / gold film: the two free margins
A: second wall middle; B: its root.
Only the last small panel folds onto its mate.
The free film margin follows that panel.
The two small panels coincide geometrically.
The doubled panels move down together.
Their loose end-film margin swings up.
The wall pair is now tucked onto the top.
Its free film margin points outward.
3a Fold the whole strip at C
Use C, the opposite wall middle.
Carry the prepared top and tucked pair.
Full film blank retained; no fin-flap folds.
Green band is OUTSIDE the matched guide.
Outward: 2 layers. Body side: 4 layers here.
The last fold needs axis C for this route.
Passed local first-seal checks on 27 ratio combinations; this does not certify complete end sealing or real pneumatic actuation.
